method: Keep the reviewed 25-verb choices. For additional flexible verbs, rank non-excluded present spellings by token count, then channel count. Retain the balanced slot when its count is at least 65% and its channel coverage at least 55% of the leading eligible form. These are editorial variety thresholds, not a validated learning model. Keep fixed-subject constructions; explicitly author soler. Freeze all decisions in frequency-pilot.json.
limitations: All counts remain undisambiguated surface-form evidence. Command/declarative overlap and unflagged homographs remain possible. This screen is conservative, not exhaustive POS tagging.
